title: Detailed paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4FC3F7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0288D1'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E0E0E0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hull' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F5F5F5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#BDBDBD'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='12' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#81D4FA' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- ripples -->
  <path d='M14 79 Q22 76 30 79' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 79 Q78 76 86 79' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 86 Q30 83 40 86' stroke='#81D4FA' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 86 Q70 83 80 86' stroke='#81D4FA' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- boat hull - left side -->
  <path d='M18 72 L50 72 L44 84 L26 84 Z' fill='url(#hull)' stroke='#9E9E9E' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- boat hull - right side -->
  <path d='M82 72 L50 72 L56 84 L74 84 Z' fill='url(#hull)' stroke='#9E9E9E' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- hull fold lines -->
  <line x1='50' y1='72' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#BDBDBD' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='78' x2='68' y2='78' stroke='#BDBDBD' stroke-width='0.7' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='73' x2='34' y2='83' stroke='#CFCFCF' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='73' x2='66' y2='83' stroke='#CFCFCF' stroke-width='0.7'/>

  <!-- sail main - a big triangle paper sail -->
  <path d='M50 20 L50 70 L26 70 Z' fill='url(#sail)' stroke='#EEEEEE' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- sail fold / center crease -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- sail right triangle -->
  <path d='M50 20 L50 70 L74 70 Z' fill='#F0F0F0' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#D6D6D6' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- sail bottom fold detail -->
  <path d='M30 64 L50 64 L70 64' stroke='#E8E8E8' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>

  <!-- mast -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#8D6E63' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- mast top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='1.5' fill='#A1887F'/>

  <!-- little flag at top -->
  <path d='M50 17 L60 21 L50 25 Z' fill='#FF7043' stroke='#FF8A65' stroke-width='0.5'/>

  <!-- boat front angle / bow highlight -->
  <path d='M18 72 L50 72 L44 84 L26 84 Z' fill='none' stroke='#FAFAFA' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <path d='M82 72 L50 72 L56 84 L74 84 Z' fill='none' stroke='#FAFAFA' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- deck top edge -->
  <path d='M18 72 L82 72' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 73 L80 73' stroke='#BDBDBD' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- small paper fold details on sails -->
  <path d='M38 30 L42 34 L38 38' stroke='#E8E8E8' stroke-width='0.6' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M62 40 L58 44 L62 48' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='0.6' fill='none'/>

  <!-- gentle shadow under boat -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#0277BD' opacity='0.3'/>
</svg>
